zh.summary: 用有明確目標、但不透露操作答案的任務觀察使用者，將觀察、推論與改版假設分開。
objectives: 設計缺漏、補正與匯出的目標任務。
記錄操作與提示介入，不把推論當觀察。
用小範圍改善與再試用檢驗設計假設。

readingGuide.goal: 設計缺漏、補正與匯出的目標任務。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 可操作的本機第三切片、一位自願同儕、合成任務卡與空白紀錄表。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份匿名任務觀察紀錄與可再測的設計假設；尚未有人試用時保留未執行。

sections.heading: 測試的是使用者能否完成工作
paragraphs: 程式測試已確認按鈕與規則，仍要知道人是否看懂欄位、發現缺漏並取得可用報告。任務導向易用性測試觀察參與者實際做什麼，比只問「好不好用」更容易定位問題。
先決定要研究的問題，例如「缺漏提示是否讓人知道如何補正」。課堂同儕可以幫忙找初步差距，但未必代表真實領域使用者；一次順利不能推成所有人皆可用。

sections.heading: 像請人依路標找到目的地
paragraphs: 如果你一路說「走這邊、按那裡」，到達終點只能證明對方能跟著指示，無法知道路標是否清楚。任務應交代目的與可用資料，讓參與者自行選擇操作。
需要協助時可以提供，但要記錄何時及提示內容，將獨立完成與協助完成分開。不要為了得到漂亮結果，把卡住的過程從紀錄刪除。

sections.heading: 給目標，保留探索空間
paragraphs: 以下任務只用合成資料，分階段提供資料。主持人不要預先說出按鈕名稱、缺漏提示的位置或操作順序；這些正是要觀察的設計。
任務結束再詢問參與者當時如何理解訊息，避免在進行中用暗示問題誘導答案。測的是服務，不評判參與者能力。

blocks.heading: 同儕任務卡
paragraphs: 先給第一段，參與者處理完後才給補充資料；不預填觀察結果。
blocks.code:
任務一：你收到 SYN-001 的合成申請，申請人代號 DEMO-A，
目前沒有文件類型。請判斷這筆資料能否產生完整報告，並處理你發現的問題。

任務二：現在補充文件類型為「合成申請表」。
請取得一份可交給同事核對的報告。

任務三：這筆資料的文件類型剛被撤回。
請更新資料，判斷先前結果現在是否仍適用。

sections.heading: 先記發生什麼，再討論為什麼
paragraphs: 觀察可寫「看到缺漏後回到文件類型欄，補值後未重新檢查」；推論可寫「可能以為補值就會自動更新結果」。兩者分欄，後者需要詢問或再測，不能寫成參與者一定怎麼想。
記錄任務是否完成、是否得到協助、卡住位置與錯誤復原。若量時間，要先定義起訖及協助如何處理；本課不預設秒數門檻或宣稱已量得改善率。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從觀察形成可測的改善
blocks.description: 這是研究與修改循環，沒有真人觀察時不要補上假結果。

items.title: 觀察任務
items.body: 保留操作、停頓、錯誤及介入。

items.title: 形成假設
items.body: 區分看見的行為與可能原因。

items.title: 小步改善
items.body: 選一項與觀察相關的文案或流程修改。

items.title: 重新試用
items.body: 用一致目標觀察是否改善，保留限制。

sections.heading: 一份可供課堂使用的觀察表
paragraphs: 先說明目的與紀錄方式，取得參與者同意；課堂可用匿名代號，不記個資或真實業務資料。錄影不是完成此練習的必要條件，若需錄製另先確認同意與保存方式。
以下工作表為空白模板，請填真實事件。主持人自己的自測另標為準備或流程檢查，不寫成另一位使用者的結果。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜任務觀察紀錄欄位
rows: 指出本次測哪份程式、哪個目標
只記實際觀察；原話需忠實
記是否介入及提示內容
獨立完成／協助完成／未完成
一項變更及其後驗證方式

sections.heading: 把結果轉成下一次可驗證修改
paragraphs: 「大家都覺得簡單」缺少參與者、任務與觀察範圍。請改寫為本次何種情境、出現哪個行為及接下來要驗什麼，讓後續設計有依據。
M08 的十五分鐘實作包含規則、介面與同儕任務的短練習。時間不足時留下未完成及課後安排，不能把備妥任務卡或出席記成真人試用已通過。

exercise.environment: 可操作的本機第三切片、一位自願同儕、合成任務卡與空白紀錄表。
steps: 說明目的與紀錄方式，取得同意後提供任務，不透露按鈕操作答案。
觀察缺漏、補正與變更，記錄協助、完成情況及實際行為。
分開觀察與推論，提出一項改善假設；修改後再安排一致目標的試用。
exercise.expected: 一份匿名任務觀察紀錄與可再測的設計假設；尚未有人試用時保留未執行。
exercise.check: 不編造參與者或結果，不把同儕單次觀察推成所有使用者結論。
exercise.cleanup: 停止測試服務，依已說明方式保存匿名紀錄，刪除不需要的合成下載。

en.summary: Observe users through goal-based tasks without giving away actions, separating observations, interpretations and redesign hypotheses.
objectives: Design goal-based tasks for omissions, correction and export.
Record actions and facilitator assistance without treating inference as observation.
Test design hypotheses through bounded changes and another trial.

readingGuide.goal: Design goal-based tasks for omissions, correction and export.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A working local third slice, one voluntary peer, synthetic task cards and a blank record.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: An anonymous task-observation record and testable design hypothesis; mark unexecuted if no person has tried it.

sections.heading: Test Whether People Can Complete Their Work
paragraphs: Program tests verify buttons and rules, but people must still understand fields, notice omissions and obtain usable reports. Task-based usability testing observes what participants actually do, making problems easier to locate than asking only whether they like the app.

Choose a research question first, such as whether omission feedback explains how to correct input. Classroom peers can reveal initial gaps but may not represent domain users. One smooth trial does not establish usability for everyone.

sections.heading: Ask Someone to Find a Destination Using the Signs
paragraphs: If you keep saying “this way” and “press here,” reaching the destination shows the participant can follow directions, not whether signs are clear. Give the goal and available information, leaving the actions to the participant.
You may help when needed, recording when and what you said. Separate independent from assisted completion and preserve moments of difficulty rather than deleting them to improve the reported result.

sections.heading: Give the Goal and Leave Room to Explore
paragraphs: The following tasks use synthetic data supplied in stages. Do not reveal button names, error locations or action order in advance; those are part of the design being observed.
After the task, ask how the participant understood messages. Avoid leading questions during the task. You are testing the service rather than judging participant ability.

blocks.heading: Peer Task Card
paragraphs: Give the first part before the supplemental information and fill no observation in advance. The unchanged Traditional Chinese card sets three goals: for SYN-001 and DEMO-A without document type, determine whether a complete report is possible and address problems; next, receive document type “合成申請表” (synthetic application form) and obtain a report for a colleague to inspect; finally, the type is withdrawn, so update the record and decide whether the previous result still applies.
blocks.code:
任務一：你收到 SYN-001 的合成申請，申請人代號 DEMO-A，
目前沒有文件類型。請判斷這筆資料能否產生完整報告，並處理你發現的問題。

任務二：現在補充文件類型為「合成申請表」。
請取得一份可交給同事核對的報告。

任務三：這筆資料的文件類型剛被撤回。
請更新資料，判斷先前結果現在是否仍適用。

sections.heading: Record What Happened Before Explaining Why
paragraphs: An observation might be “after seeing the omission, the participant filled document type but did not recheck.” A separate interpretation might be “they may expect automatic result updates.” Ask or retest before treating the interpretation as established understanding.

Record completion, assistance, points of difficulty and error recovery. If measuring time, define start/end and handling of assistance first. This course supplies no arbitrary time threshold or measured improvement percentage.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Turn Observation into a Testable Improvement
blocks.description: This is a research/change cycle. Supply no invented findings when human observation has not happened.

items.title: Observe a task
items.body: Retain actions, pauses, errors and interventions.

items.title: Form a hypothesis
items.body: Separate observed behavior from possible causes.

items.title: Make a small improvement
items.body: Choose one related wording or flow change.

items.title: Try again
items.body: Observe the same goal, preserving limitations.

sections.heading: A Classroom Observation Worksheet
paragraphs: Explain purpose and recording methods and obtain participant agreement first. Use anonymous codes, retaining no personal or real business data. Recording video is unnecessary; if you choose to record, confirm agreement and retention separately beforehand.
The worksheet is blank for actual events. Label the facilitator’s self-test as preparation or a flow check, rather than reporting it as another user’s result.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Task-observation Record Fields
rows: Identify the program and goal tested.
Record whether/when you intervened and the prompt given.
One change and its subsequent verification method.

sections.heading: Turn Findings into the Next Verifiable Change
paragraphs: “Everyone found it simple” lacks participants, tasks and observation scope. Describe the actual situation, behavior and next check so design decisions have evidence.

M08’s fifteen practical minutes include short rule, interface and peer-task exercises. If time runs out, record unfinished work and follow-up. Prepared task cards or attendance do not establish successful human trials.

exercise.environment: A working local third slice, one voluntary peer, synthetic task cards and a blank record.
steps: Explain purpose and recording, obtain agreement, then give tasks without revealing button actions.
Observe omission, correction and change; record assistance, completion and actual behavior.
Separate observations from interpretations and propose one improvement hypothesis; after changing it, arrange another trial with the same goal.
exercise.expected: An anonymous task-observation record and testable design hypothesis; mark unexecuted if no person has tried it.
exercise.check: Invent no participants or results. Do not generalize one peer observation to all users.
exercise.cleanup: Stop the test service, retain anonymous records as explained and delete unnecessary synthetic downloads.

zh.prompt: 哪個任務較適合觀察易用性？
options: 請取得可交給同事核對的合成報告
rationales: 給目標並保留操作選擇。

en.prompt: Which task better supports usability observation?
options: Obtain a synthetic report a colleague can inspect.
rationales: That directs the participant to a control.
It gives a goal while leaving action choices open.

zh.prompt: 「參與者一定不懂完整性」屬於什麼？
rationales: 應先記行為再確認理解。

en.prompt: “The participant definitely does not understand completeness” is what kind of statement?
rationales: There is no direct observational basis.
Record behavior first, then check understanding.

zh.prompt: 主持人提示後完成任務，該如何記錄？
options: 協助完成，保留提示內容與時機

en.prompt: The facilitator helped and the participant completed the task. How should this be recorded?
options: Assisted completion with the prompt and timing retained.
